about: Walter Decision 2.0 bench corpus (2026-11-17). Synthetic only: no owner message, names and companies are invented. Reference day 2026-11-17 (a Tuesday). Split fixed before any run: `cal` cases may tune thresholds, `test` cases are only reported. Gold labels only where the answer is objective; a missing key = not scored. needs: what the answer must have (a miss is critical); needs_not: what it must not get.
